summary: A menu-bar popover with your inbox, quick compose, and update status one click from the tray.
added: A tray popover: click the menu-bar icon for Open Inbox, New Message, Settings, and the current update status, without opening the full window.
An unread count on the dock icon and the tray, read from the mailbox.
improved: The tray icon left-click now opens the popover; the plain menu is still there on right-click.

summary: Fixes automatic updates on macOS and Linux, and adds one-line install commands.
added: Install from a terminal: one command sets Taifa Mail up on macOS, Windows or Linux and picks the right build for your machine.
fixed: Automatic updates on macOS and Linux. The app would find a new version and then fail to download it, so it could never update itself. Windows was not affected.

summary: The first Taifa Mail desktop app: a walking skeleton that puts your webmail in a real window.
added: A desktop window that loads the Taifa Mail webmail at mail.govconnect.ke, signed in exactly as it is in your browser.
A tray icon so Taifa Mail stays reachable while it is out of the way.
Automatic updates: the app checks for new versions and installs them for you.
Navigation lock, so links that lead away from Taifa Mail open in your normal browser instead of taking over the app window.
